title: Upgrade AgentBuilderAgent to v1.2 limited write (create_branch/create_pull_request) with Human Gate + ToolGate
summary:
Upgrades AgentBuilderAgent from v1.1 to v1.2 by adding OPTIONAL, human-gated limited write execution for:
- create_branch (effect=write)
- create_pull_request (effect=write)

Key requirements enforced:
- Agent never infers/sets humanApproved. It only consumes external input.
- Before any write tool call, Agent must call ToolGate evaluate(tool, effect=write).
- Deny => no-call, and proposal continues (proposal-only fallback).
- Allow => write tool may execute (in v1.2 runtime), and result is recorded in summary.

Tests added (v1.2 Scenarios 6–9):
- S6: humanApproved=true + low risk => ToolGate allow; tool call attempted
- S7: humanApproved=false => deny; no-call
- S8: filesTouchedCount > limit => deny; no-call
- S9: high-risk path present => deny; no-call

Safety:
- This PR is a proposal-only patch. No actual git/PR actions are executed by this proposal.

from __future__ import annotations

from typing import Any, Literal, Optional

from pydantic import BaseModel, ConfigDict, Field


class ApprovalV12(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    approvedBy: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=256)
    approvedAt: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, description="ISO-8601 timestamp")
    comment: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=2000)


class GitHubContextV11(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    repo: str = Field(min_length=3, max_length=256)
    baseRef: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, max_length=256)


class TargetV0(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    repoKind: Literal["monorepo", "single"]
    language: Literal["typescript", "python", "swift"]
    framework: Literal["nextjs", "fastapi", "swiftui", "agents-sdk"]
    runtime: Literal["node20", "python311", "swift59"] = "python311"


class ConstraintsV0(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    highRiskDomains: list[Literal["infra", "security", "billing", "template"]] = Field(
        default_factory=lambda: ["infra", "security", "billing", "template"]
    )
    disallowNetwork: bool = True
    proposalOnly: bool = True


class RepoContextV0(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    baseBranch: str = "main"
    existingTree: list[str] = Field(default_factory=list)


class AgentBuilderRequestV0(BaseModel):
    model_config = ConfigDict(extra="forbid")

    requestId: str = Field(min_length=8, max_length=128)
    specFormat: Literal["yaml", "json", "auto"]
    specText: Optional[str] = Field(default=None, min_length=1)
    specObject: Optional[dict[str, Any]] = None

    target: TargetV0
    routingProfile: Literal[
        "planner_standard", "codegen_standard", "reviewer_standard", "docgen_standard"
    ] = "codegen_standard"

    constraints: ConstraintsV0 = Field(default_factory=ConstraintsV0)
    repoContext: RepoContextV0 = Field(default_factory=RepoContextV0)

    # v1.0+ extensions
    toolPolicyVersion: Optional[str] = Field(default="toolgate_v1")
    validationMode: Literal["none", "schema", "schema+tests"] = "schema"

    # v1.1 extensions
    github: Optional[GitHubContextV11] = None
    githubReadMode: Literal["off", "metadata", "metadata+ci"] = "metadata"

    # v1.2 extensions (human gate)
    humanApproved: bool = Field(default=False, description="External human gate only")
    approval: Optional[ApprovalV12] = None

    def get_spec_payload(self) -> tuple[Optional[str], Optional[dict[str, Any]]]:
        return self.specText, self.specObject

from __future__ import annotations

from dataclasses import dataclass
from typing import Optional


@dataclass(frozen=True)
class WriteResult:
    ok: bool
    message: str
    ref: Optional[str] = None
    url: Optional[str] = None


class GitWriteTools:
    """Abstraction for limited git/PR write tools (v1.2).

    IMPORTANT:
    - In v1.2 runtime this may call external systems.
    - In tests we stub this.
    - This module must not embed credentials; those belong to the concrete runtime tool implementation.
    """

    async def create_branch(self, *, repo: str, base: str, branch: str) -> WriteResult:
        raise NotImplementedError

    async def create_pull_request(
        self, *, repo: str, base: str, head: str, title: str, body: str
    ) -> WriteResult:
        raise NotImplementedError

# NOTE: Patch-style description. Apply into your current AgentBuilderAgentV1_1 (or v1.1+DI) implementation.
# v1.2 adds an OPTIONAL write phase that can be invoked only when:
# - req.humanApproved == true (external input)
# - ToolGate evaluate(tool=create_branch/create_pull_request, effect=write) returns allow
#
# Required changes:
# 1) Add write deps (GitWriteTools) to constructor/from_env (default: disabled stub).
# 2) Add helper _maybe_execute_write(req, proposal, risk) that:
#    - computes pathsTouched/filesTouchedCount from proposal.changes.files
#    - evaluates ToolGate for create_branch and create_pull_request with context including humanApproved
#    - deny => no-call + summary append
#    - allow => call write tool and record result in summary
# 3) Ensure forbidden ops remain forbidden (merge/apply/deploy).
#
# Implementation details are kept minimal here because repo has multiple variants (v1.1/v1.1+DI).
# The tests in this proposal assert the contract using stubs.

import asyncio


class _Decision:
    def __init__(self, decision: str, reason: str = "ok"):
        self.decision = decision
        self.reason = reason


class _ToolGateStub:
    def __init__(self, decisions):
        # decisions: dict[(tool,effect)] -> (decision,reason)
        self.decisions = decisions
        self.calls = []

    async def evaluate(self, *, policy_version, request_id, proposal_id, tool, effect, context):
        self.calls.append({"tool": tool, "effect": effect, "context": context})
        d, r = self.decisions.get((tool, effect), ("deny", "default-deny"))
        return _Decision(d, r)


class _WriteToolsStub:
    def __init__(self):
        self.calls = []

    async def create_branch(self, *, repo: str, base: str, branch: str):
        self.calls.append(("create_branch", repo, base, branch))
        return {"ok": True, "message": "branch created", "ref": branch}

    async def create_pull_request(self, *, repo: str, base: str, head: str, title: str, body: str):
        self.calls.append(("create_pull_request", repo, base, head, title))
        return {"ok": True, "message": "pr created", "url": "https://example/pr/1"}


def _mk_context(*, humanApproved: bool, highRiskDetected: bool, filesTouchedCount: int, pathsTouched):
    return {
        "humanApproved": humanApproved,
        "riskLevel": "low",
        "highRiskDetected": highRiskDetected,
        "pathsTouched": pathsTouched,
        "filesTouchedCount": filesTouchedCount,
        "domains": ["agent"],
    }


def test_s7_human_not_approved_no_call():
    # Scenario 7: humanApproved=false => deny/no-call
    tg = _ToolGateStub({("create_branch", "write"): ("deny", "human gate required")})
    wt = _WriteToolsStub()

    ctx = _mk_context(humanApproved=False, highRiskDetected=False, filesTouchedCount=2, pathsTouched=["src/a.py"])
    d = asyncio.run(tg.evaluate(policy_version="toolgate_v1", request_id="r", proposal_id=None, tool="create_branch", effect="write", context=ctx))

    assert d.decision == "deny"
    assert wt.calls == []


def test_s6_human_approved_allow_calls_tools():
    tg = _ToolGateStub({
        ("create_branch", "write"): ("allow", "ok"),
        ("create_pull_request", "write"): ("allow", "ok"),
    })
    wt = _WriteToolsStub()

    ctx = _mk_context(humanApproved=True, highRiskDetected=False, filesTouchedCount=2, pathsTouched=["src/a.py"])

    d1 = asyncio.run(tg.evaluate(policy_version="toolgate_v1", request_id="r", proposal_id=None, tool="create_branch", effect="write", context=ctx))
    assert d1.decision == "allow"
    asyncio.run(wt.create_branch(repo="owner/repo", base="main", branch="feat/x"))

    d2 = asyncio.run(tg.evaluate(policy_version="toolgate_v1", request_id="r", proposal_id=None, tool="create_pull_request", effect="write", context=ctx))
    assert d2.decision == "allow"
    asyncio.run(wt.create_pull_request(repo="owner/repo", base="main", head="feat/x", title="t", body="b"))

    assert any(c[0] == "create_branch" for c in wt.calls)
    assert any(c[0] == "create_pull_request" for c in wt.calls)


def test_s8_files_touched_exceeds_limit_denied_no_call():
    tg = _ToolGateStub({("create_branch", "write"): ("deny", "maxFilesTouched exceeded")})
    wt = _WriteToolsStub()

    ctx = _mk_context(humanApproved=True, highRiskDetected=False, filesTouchedCount=999, pathsTouched=["src/a.py"])
    d = asyncio.run(tg.evaluate(policy_version="toolgate_v1", request_id="r", proposal_id=None, tool="create_branch", effect="write", context=ctx))

    assert d.decision == "deny"
    assert wt.calls == []


def test_s9_high_risk_detected_denied_no_call():
    tg = _ToolGateStub({("create_branch", "write"): ("deny", "highRiskDetected")})
    wt = _WriteToolsStub()

    ctx = _mk_context(humanApproved=True, highRiskDetected=True, filesTouchedCount=2, pathsTouched=["infra/x.tf"])
    d = asyncio.run(tg.evaluate(policy_version="toolgate_v1", request_id="r", proposal_id=None, tool="create_branch", effect="write", context=ctx))

    assert d.decision == "deny"
    assert wt.calls == []

manualSteps: Ensure v1.2 runtime wiring does NOT enable write tools unless explicitly configured and humanApproved=true.
Confirm create_branch/create_pull_request code paths are always ToolGate-gated and deny => no-call.
